cards.label: Bermondsey - James's workshop
cards.text: Archie has pushed two benches together and set a Tesco meal deal at each place. Owen has been given a chair again.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Board meeting. Every Monday, catering provided." He taps his sandwich. "Three pitches, one goal each. You pick which one we chase this week."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Next Monday I read the minutes and we find out whether you chose well. Choose anything. Nobody is wounded if it isn't theirs."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Worst you'll get is 'next week, then'. Then I pitch again, louder."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "You're getting poached, Owen. Different department. Start Friday." James does not look up. "He is not."

choices.label: Leave it to Archie
choices.result_text: "You weren't there, so you're doing mine."

cards.text: Any other business. James asks that the benches be put back exactly where they were. Owen asks which of them is Friday.
